findings.text: Acceptance 2/3: the status watermark acknowledges undelivered member mentions. In-memory createFeed reproduction: resume (null,10), status=51, mention 51; hold onItem's promise and stop/restart -> saved=(51,10), delivered=[], mentionCursor=51. The resumedFrom check permanently skips 51. Removing the eager cursor assignment in memory restores delivered=[51]. Separate the stream bootstrap watermark from delivered state and preserve pending mentions across restarts.

Acceptance 4/5: claiming a refreshed record temporarily hides its wake target. In-memory pruneSessions reproduction: refresh in afterSelect; submit a valid signed wake in afterClaim -> 202 woke:false, reason='no recorded session'; after restoration, retry -> 409 replay; runner calls=0. The wake is permanently lost although the refreshed record survives. Synchronize wake reads with pruning or safely expose claimed fresh records to readers.

Original reproductions: F1 ADDRESSED (unbound secret refused; no B wake); F7 ADDRESSED (50 records, refreshed target survives); F8 ADDRESSED (SIGTERM heartbeat 51, takeover delivers 52); F9 ADDRESSED (null cursor delivers mention 51 with/without status). In-memory checks, 14 targeted tests and typecheck passed. Full npm test was not run under read-only restrictions; secrets scan failed creating its temporary directory (EPERM). Re-run both gates in a writable test environment.
